sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hová*? asks where someone is going. Use a destination form with movement verbs such as *megy* and jön.

items.english: Károly is going to the shop.

sections.content: Hová has that little á on the end pointing forward, almost like an arrow — a handy visual reminder that this is the ‘where TO’ question, not the ‘where AT’ one. If you can picture the accent as motion, you’ll stop confusing it with Hol?
